articles.summary: GBLI reports third quarter 2026 results before market open on November 4, as scheduled WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Global Indemnity Group, LLC (NASDAQ: GBLI) (“GBLI” or the “Company”) plans an investor call in January to introduce Jessica Buss, its new Chief Executive Officer, who will set out her vision for GBLI and her priorities for building its businesses. GBLI will announce the date, time and access details in a separate release. Ms. Buss’s call replaces the third quarter 2026 earnings call set for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern. GBLI will release its third quarter results before market open that morning, as scheduled. About GBLI GBLI is a publicly traded holding company with a diversified portfolio of property and casualty insurance-related operating companies, organized in three groups: Katalyx Holdings LLC Four agencies that source, underwrite and service primary and assumed reinsurance business: Penn-America Insurance Services, LLC;
articles.title: Global Indemnity Group to Host Investor Call with New CEO Jessica Buss

articles.summary: Wilmington, Del., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Global Indemnity Group, LLC (Nasdaq: GBLI) (the "Company") today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, net income was $8.9 million, or $0.61 per share, compared to $12.5 million, or $0.86 per share, in 2025. Current accident year underwriting income was $5.6 million, with a loss ratio of 53.0% and a current accident year combined ratio of 94.8%. Belmont Core gross written premiums of $102.6 million were 5.5% lower than 2025. Pretax Adjusted Operating Contribution was $20.1 million and Adjusted Return on Equity was 12.8%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income was $24.2 million, or $1.65 per share, compared to $18.9 million, or $1.30 per share, in 2025. Current accident year underwriting income increased to $16.9 million from $5.4 million in 2025, with a loss ratio of 53.8% and a current accident year combined ratio of 94.7%.
articles.title: Global Indemnity Group, LLC Reports Financial Results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026

articles.summary: Specialty insurance builder to lead GBLI, Katalyx and Belmont and put the Company’s proprietary technology and national distribution to work WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of Global Indemnity Group, LLC (NASDAQ: GBLI) (“GBLI” or the “Company”) today appointed Jessica E. Buss Chief Executive Officer of GBLI and of its two operating platforms, Katalyx Holdings LLC and Belmont Holdings GX, Inc., effective immediately. Ms. Buss joined GBLI’s Board on October 26, 2026, and remains a director. She succeeds Joseph W. “Jay” Brown, GBLI’s chief executive officer since 2022. Ms. Buss spent most of her career building specialty insurance businesses. As CEO of GuideOne Insurance, she doubled premiums. She also led Argo Group and Open Lending as CEO. At Open Lending, she also served as Chairman of the Board and chaired its Audit Committee prior to becoming CEO. Earlier, as COO and CFO of Rockhill Insurance, she led its sale to State Auto Mutual for 1.6x
